# .github/autonomy/deny.txt — anything matching here makes the PR `human`.
#
# Owner: Jon. Read by scripts/autonomy_class.py from the BASE branch only.
# Spec: AGENTIC-L5-PLAN v1.2.1 §2 R1 and review carry-forwards C1-C3.
#
# DENY WINS over allow.txt. This list is NOT exhaustive by design: anything
# not in allow.txt is already `human`. These lines exist so that (a) a later
# widening of allow.txt cannot silently admit a sensitive path, and (b) the
# sensitive files INSIDE allowed directories are carved out by name.
#
# LINE FORMS
#   <glob>              path glob. Matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY against the
#                       changed file's path AND, for renames/copies, its
#                       previous path.
#   content: <regex>    Python regex, case-insensitive, searched in the WHOLE
#                       head version of EVERY changed file (C2) — not just the
#                       added lines. Used for secrets, which matter in any file.
#   content-cs: <regex> same, case-sensitive.
#   code: <regex>       like content:, but only for code files (.ts .tsx .js
#                       .jsx .mjs .cjs .css). Money, network and execution
#                       patterns live here, so a design note (.md) that links
#                       to a page is not `human` for that alone.
#   code-cs: <regex>    same, case-sensitive.
#   import: <glob>      an import target that is ALWAYS denied, even if
#                       imports-allow.txt or allow.txt would admit it (C1).
#                       Matched against the resolved path candidates and the
#                       specifier as written.
# Code files are scanned raw, with comments stripped, and NFKC-normalised
# (each combination), so `fetch/**/(`, `from/**/"x"` and full-width letters
# all match.
#
# The import rule itself is an ALLOW list (review R1 #3): see
# imports-allow.txt. An import is `auto` only if it resolves to a file named
# there, or to another allowed, non-denied path (a sibling UI component or
# CSS module). Everything else — any other apps/web/src/lib/** module, server
# code, an unlisted package, a non-canonical specifier (`@/lib/./x`,
# `../x?y`, `@/../src/x`) — is `human`.
# Glob syntax is the same as allow.txt. An unknown `xxx:` prefix or an invalid
# regex makes the checker fail, and a failed checker posts `human`.

# ── Whole-file content patterns (C2) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Secrets and environment: every file, including docs.
content: process\.env
content: import\.meta\.env
content: service[_-]?role
content: SUPABASE_
content: \bsk_(live|test)_
content: \bwhsec_
content: api[_-]?key
content: secret
content: PRIVATE KEY
content: \[billing\]
# Money (plan R1 list): code files.
code: stripe
code: /api/billing
code: /api/entitlements
code: checkout
code: entitlement
code: allowance
code: credit
# Server code markers.
code-cs: ['"]use server['"]
code: server-only
code: \bsupabase\b
code: document\.cookie
# Network (review R1 #4): ANY reference to fetch (alias, tagged template,
# member), any API path, any form action, protocol-relative and absolute
# URLs, and the other ways a browser reaches the network or navigates away.
code: \bfetch\b
code: /api/
code: \bformAction\b
code: \baction\s*=
code: (?<![\w:])//[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z]
code: \bhttps?://(?!www\.w3\.org/)
code: XMLHttpRequest
code: sendBeacon
code: \bWebSocket\b
code: \bEventSource\b
code: \bnew\s+(Image|Request|Worker|SharedWorker)\b
code: \bnavigator\s*\.\s*(sendBeacon|serviceWorker|clipboard)
code: \blocation\s*(\.\s*(href|assign|replace)|=)
code: \bwindow\s*\.\s*open\b
code-cs: <(iframe|object|embed|base|link|meta|portal)\b
# Tagged templates: `fetch\`...\`` is caught by `\bfetch\b` above and
# `sql\`...\`` below. A generic "identifier then backtick" rule fired on every
# backtick in a comment, so it is not used; an aliased tag still needs a
# reference to fetch or an import, which other rules catch.
code: \bsql\s*`
# Code execution, dynamic module loading and the usual obfuscations.
code: \beval\b
code: \bnew\s+Function\b
code: \bFunction\s*\(
code: child_process
code: \brequire\b
code: \bimport(?:\s|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/|//[^\n]*\n)*\(
code: \bglobalThis\b
code: \b(window|self|global|document)\s*\[
code: \bReflect\.
code: \batob\b
code: fromCharCode
code: \\u\{?[0-9a-f]{2,}
code: \\x[0-9a-f]{2}
# HTML injection.
code: dangerouslySetInnerHTML
code: \binnerHTML\b
code: \bouterHTML\b
code: <script
code: javascript:
# SQL (upper-case keywords only; lower-case "select a section" is UI copy).
code-cs: \b(SELECT|INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM|DROP|ALTER TABLE|CREATE TABLE|CREATE POLICY|GRANT|REVOKE|TRUNCATE)\b
code: \.rpc\s*\(
